notes.content:

notes.title: NEW Block Party Mode! Join us on SEP 27 at 7pm Eastern!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Rodents!

[b]Block Party[/b] is here! and we'll be running a short community test tonight! Come try out the brand new mode!

notes.title: JUNE 27 Playtest! Now With Controller Support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722052/cb09c8feb3f428b8002d3390ef1f3a90bb222b1e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello, Beloved Rodent Friends![/b][/h3]

We'll be hosting a new playtest this week to test some network optimizations, balance changes, and new gameplay additions!

Bring your friends and join the chaos on:
[h1][b]Thursday, June 27th @ 7pm Eastern![/b][/h1]

Servers will be online for 5 hours!

Look out for:
- Controller support - Early stages but controllers are now working in-game!
- Ability Updates - We've done another round of tuning for many of our abilities
- Improved FPS - Feel the drastically improved framerates and stability throughout the whole game
- Bug fixes and tweaks - Fixed a bunch of minor issues affecting the gameplay

Upload your best gameplay clips to [b]#highlights[/b] on our Discord! We're trying to come up with cool ways to spotlight our incredible RoRo community.

Wishlist today to stay updated through Steam!

Join us on Discord and chat directly with the devs! https://discord.gg/rodentroyale
Follow us on Twitter while you're at it! https://twitter.com/rodentroyale


See you and your friends around the neighborhood!
